text:
Alex: Quick sync — noticed p95 on route 'summarize-api' jumped after the recent kernel switchover. Planning a small experiment: add a lightweight route-level 'token sweeper' that reassigns unused token budget from quiet routes to busy ones to hit p95 SLOs per tier. Thoughts? :eyes:

Priya: Can you paste the numbers you're seeing and the exact kernel change? want to confirm regression vs variance.

Alex: Repro below (single-day window, canaries rolled during kernel bump):
```
profile_snapshot:
  kernel_old_select_ms: 1.1
  kernel_new_select_ms: 4.3
  avg_microbatch_tokens: 24 -> 28
  kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.16 -> 0.39
  route:summarize-api p95_latency_ms: 190 -> 345
  error-rate: 0.02% -> 0.08%
```
Looks like kernel pick increased select time and KV miss rate spiked (maybe more microbatch fragmentation), causing tail blowup.

Mateo: Hmm. If microbatches are smaller or misaligned we get more KV traffic and kernel warmups. Sweeper sounds ok but we should avoid stealing tokens from very latency-sensitive tiers. propose a config to test: 
```
sweeper:
  enabled: true
  interval_ms: 40
  min_reassign_tokens: 4
  max_reassign_tokens: 48
  per_route_floor_tokens: 8
  target_p95_ms_by_tier:
    prod: 220
    gold: 160
    free: 320
```
Run on 1% traffic first.

Lina: +1 but watch KV churn. If we dynamically change budgets mid-request we might evict useful KV entries. Add a conservative KV-warmup hook: when we increase a route's token cap, prefetch top-2 KV segments for that prefix. Also emit kv_hit_ratio and kv_evictions per route.

Priya: Agree. Need rollback criteria. My suggestion: abort if p95 increases > 10% vs baseline or kv_eviction_rate increases by absolute 0.05 within 5m, or error-rate > 0.2%. Also log kernel_select_ms histogram.

Alex: Canary plan: 2% of production routed to dedicated canary pool, sweep enabled, collect metrics for 30m windows. Baseline: previous 24h median p95 for route. Roll forward if p95 delta <= +3% and error-rate delta <= +0.03%. Rollback if Priya's abort triggers.

qa-bot: Please post exact prometheus queries for the canary dashboard and the artifact version pinned for the canary. also add an eval prompt set for summarize-api so we can run synthetic traffic.

Alex: Added dashboard queries (snippet):
```
# p95 for route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="summarize-api",pool="canary"}[5m])) by (le))
# kv hit ratio
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits{route="summarize-api"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests{route="summarize-api"}[5m]))
```
Artifact: inference-runtime:v2026.3-kernelB-canary

ops-bot: deploy started to canary pool (inference-runtime:v2026.3-kernelB-canary) :rocket:

ops-bot: deploy completed, 2% canary healthy :white_check_mark:

Mateo: Early checks (first 15m): p95 down ~2% for summarize-api, kv_hit_ratio improved slightly (0.62 -> 0.65). kernel_select_ms variance still a bit wider but not regressive.

Lina: Good sign. Keep an eye on cross-route effects — if sweeper pulls tokens away from 'extract-api' that one could regress. We added per_route_floor_tokens to protect that.

Priya: After 60m: p95 aggregate across tiers stable, but a few spurts at 10-12m mark where kv_evictions spiked (0.06 absolute). Still under abort threshold but we should tighten prefetch.

Alex: Action items: 1) increase prefetch to top-3 KV segments on budget bump, 2) add metric kv_eviction_by_prefix, 3) extend canary to 8% for 2h if next 30m stays green. I'll open the rollout ticket and schedule the extension.

Mateo: Also posted a tiny kernel-side optimization that reduces select_ms on small microbatches by ~0.6ms — can be part of follow-up.

Priya: Thanks all. If canary stays green we'll proceed with staged ramp and monitor p95 per tier. Ping me for final cutoff. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks — will update thread with extension result.
